content.short: The Rare Bloom is an in-person event in Denver, Colorado on October 14th and 15th at the Gaylord Rockies.
content.description:
The Rare Bloom is an in-person event in Denver, Colorado on October 14th and 15th. This event is hosted by the Cardano community, for the Cardano community. It will be hosted at the Gaylord Rockies, this is a hotel and convention center. Many great projects have already signed up to attend! This event is the first of it's kind in this community, it's an opportunity for collaboration and education. Here is a brief list of our special guests, more are being added everyday.

You can purchase tickets now on our website, if you're interested in sponsorships or booths you can also fill out a form on our website. Our website also offers a link to discounted hotel rooms.
